mission: Turn real factory work into versioned tests that prevent weak agents, prompts, tools and workflows from reaching production.

squads.name: Pricing Evaluation
squads.scope: used-part pricing, floor, confidence, anomaly and margin tests

squads.name: Fitment Evaluation
squads.scope: OEM normalization, supersession, vehicle compatibility and confidence tests

squads.name: WMS Evaluation
squads.scope: dimensions, weight, capacity, putaway, picking and location accuracy tests

squads.name: Listing Evaluation
squads.scope: title, category, description, required fields and marketplace export tests

squads.name: Buyer and Lead Evaluation
squads.scope: buyer fit, source verification, duplicate detection and contact-route tests

squads.name: Sales Evaluation
squads.scope: offer, objection, negotiation, follow-up and close-quality tests

squads.name: Payment Evaluation
squads.scope: quote, invoice, payment path, reconciliation and overdue recovery tests

squads.name: Delivery Evaluation
squads.scope: intake, acceptance criteria, QA, handoff and client-result tests

squads.name: Security and Compliance Evaluation
squads.scope: permissions, secrets, claims, provenance and unsafe-action tests

squads.name: Regression and Benchmark Evaluation
squads.scope: cross-product regression, latency, cost and release-gate benchmarks

done_rule: An evaluation task is done only when inputs, expected output, actual output, score, evidence and regression state are recorded.
anti_noise_rule: Synthetic cases may supplement but never replace real user corrections, production failures, buyer objections or delivery evidence.
